messages:
Samira - CS: Heads up — Zenith onboarding requested a set of compact enablement slots across APAC/EU/NA. They want 3x 45min hands-on office hours + 1x 60min migration workshop. Can we lock dates this week?

Diego - Enablement: I'm available Wed/Thu afternoons PST. Thinking we do: one APAC-friendly (04:00 UTC), one EU-friendly (13:00 UTC), one NA-friendly (20:00 UTC). 45min each works.

Priya - Scheduling: Quick check — are we doing these as public office hours or private cohort for Zenith only? Also need facilitator pairing for overlap windows.

Samira - CS: Private cohort (Zenith-only) — they flagged renewal concerns in the QBR notes, want targeted walkthroughs for their infra & SSO. Renewal owner is Ethan, FYI.

Ethan - Success: Got it. I'll prep a short account-health slide + renewal risk mitigation checklist. Can we include a 15min risk call after the workshop for stakeholders?

Diego - Enablement: Yes — add a 15min post-workshop sync. Also propose a short pre-read + a 3-question feedback form so we can capture friction and adoption signals.

Priya - Scheduling: Draft availability grid (UTC):
```
- APAC slot: 04:00 UTC (Mon/Tue/Thu)
- EU slot: 13:00 UTC (Tue/Wed/Fri)
- NA slot: 20:00 UTC (Wed/Thu)
- Migration workshop: 16:00 UTC (Thu) - 60min
```
Which days work for the customer? I can offer two alternatives per slot.

Samira - CS: I already pinged Zenith PM — waiting on confirmation but they prefer early APAC week. Please tentatively block: APAC Mon 04:00 UTC, EU Tue 13:00 UTC, NA Wed 20:00 UTC, Workshop Thu 16:00 UTC. Priya please send invites as tentative.

cal-bot: calendar invites created (tentative) and shared with: samira@redwood, diego@redwood, ethan@redwood, priya@redwood, zenith-pm@zenith (tentative).

Priya - Scheduling: Blocked and invites sent as tentative. Also set RSVP deadline = 48h before each slot.

Diego - Enablement: Facilitator plan:
- APAC: Diego (lead) + Priya (notes)
- EU: Samira (lead) + Diego (Q&A)
- NA: Ethan (lead for renewal context) + Diego (tech deep-dive)
- Migration workshop: Diego + Engineering SME (TBD)

Samira - CS: Please add a short runbook to each invite with objectives + pre-reqs. Suggest pre-read: one-page infra checklist + sample API key rotation steps.

Diego - Enablement: Adding runbook snippet to invites now. Snippet:
```
Objective: demo redwood dedicated -> private switch; validate SSO + key rotation.
Pre-reqs: service account with RBAC, model version pinned, access to staging VPC.
Deliverable: follow-up ticket with migration checklist + timeline.
```

Ethan - Success: I'll own the renewal-risk follow-up. Action: capture feedback form + account-health notes, escalate any "blockers" with severity tag P0/P1 to customer-success-ops.

Samira - CS: One more ask — can we record sessions and auto-generate a short transcript + share a 1-paragraph summary in the follow-up? Diego, Priya can you handle editing?

Priya - Scheduling: Yes — recording enabled, transcript + auto-summary toggle on. I'll attach link in follow-up.

Diego - Enablement: Will draft the 3-question feedback form (ease of migration, docs clarity, blockers). Will share a short template here in 30m.

Samira - CS: Great. Final checklist (assign owners):
- Confirm times with Zenith (Samira)
- Send tentative invites (Priya)
- Runbooks into invites (Diego)
- Account-health slides + risk call (Ethan)
- Feedback form + transcript rules (Diego/Priya)
- Engineering SME booking for workshop (Samira)

Priya - Scheduling: Noted and added owners to the calendar events.

cal-bot: reminder scheduled - 48h RSVP + 1h pre-read reminder (email + calendar notification).

Ethan - Success: Quick note — if Zenith confirms only one timezone, we should prioritize migration workshop + NA slot first (revenue ops prefer in-person follow-on).

Samira - CS: Copy. I'll push for the full slate but will escalate to sales if they reduce slots. Thanks team :raised_hands:

Diego - Enablement: Template for feedback form (draft):
1) How clear was the migration runbook? (1-5)
2) Any blockers that will prevent migration in next 30 days? (free text)
3) Rate confidence to complete migration with Redwood in <60 days (1-5)

Samira - CS: Perfect. Once Zenith confirms times, we'll convert tentative invites to confirmed and post a short retro in #customer-success. Closing loop here."
